SEO

SEO: get found on Google

SEO is everything that helps Google find your website and move it up the results. The higher it is, the more people click on it. I explain it simply.

What is SEO?

When someone searches for something on Google, they type a few words. Google then shows them a list of websites, from first to last. Almost everyone clicks on the first ones. Very few people look at the second page.

SEO (also called "organic search ranking") is all the settings that help Google find your website, understand what you do and show it as high as possible. Every click is free: it is not advertising.

An example

You are a florist in Reims. A customer types "florist Reims" into Google.

  • Without SEO, your website exists, but Google puts it on page 3. Nobody sees it.
  • With SEO, Google understands that you are a florist, in Reims, with your opening hours and your reviews. Your website moves up into the top results, and the customer calls you.

What you get out of it

More visits, more calls, more sales, without paying for each click. SEO takes time: the first results come within a few weeks, then it keeps improving.

Useful pages, not pointless pages

A big part of SEO is creating pages that lead to your website. Each page answers a specific search by your customers, for example "wedding bouquet Reims" or "flower delivery Épernay". It explains, it helps, and it leads to your main page or your contact page.

These are not useless pages stuffed with keywords: Google spots them and sets them aside. A page is only created if it is truly useful to someone.

A single main page is possible

Your website can keep a single main page, simple and clear, with everything you do. Alongside it, we add a series of pages for SEO, each on a specific topic. Your visitors see a simple website, and Google finds more good reasons to show you.

This website uses the same method. Each of its guides answers a specific question: the price of a website, choosing a domain name, the Google listing, and more.

What I do for your visibility

The technical basics

A fast, secure website that works perfectly on phones, with the tags and data Google can read.

Local SEO

Google listing, pages for your towns, customer reviews: so you show up when customers search near you.

Useful content

Monitoring, with Power

Rankings, searches, visits: I look at what works and adjust every month to move your website up.

My method, in practice

Here is what I do on every website, without exception. It is the foundation for climbing the rankings.

This website is built exactly this way: fast, ad-free, and every page tells Google who I am and what I offer.

  • Pages that load fast, measured with Google's tools
  • A title and a description written for each page
  • Structured data so Google understands your business, your prices and your opening hours
  • A site map submitted to Google, clean addresses
  • Well-planned links between your pages
  • The website registered in Google Search Console as soon as it goes live
  • A Google listing, reviews, the same details everywhere
  • Content that answers your customers' questions

What I don't promise

Nobody can guarantee first place on Google. Be wary of anyone who does.

The first results usually come within a few weeks, sometimes a few months for the most competitive searches.

I don't publish hundreds of empty pages to pad out your website: Google spots them and penalises them. I prefer less content, but truly useful to your customers.

Your questions about SEO

How long until I am on Google?

Your website is submitted to Google as soon as it goes live. People find it quickly by your name. For more competitive searches, allow a few weeks to a few months.

Which plan includes SEO?

The basics are included in every plan: Google can read your website. The monthly work to move it up is included in Power and Titan.

Can you guarantee me first place?

No, and nobody honestly can. I give you every chance and show you every month where you stand.

What is optimised content?

An article or a page that answers a real question from your customers, with clear headings and links to your services. I prepare it with AI and check it before publishing.

I already have a website. Can you improve it?

Yes. I look at your website and tell you what is holding back your visibility. Write to me for a quote.
